faqs.question: What is DriveAFM used for?
faqs.answer: It's Nanosurf's most advanced research atomic force microscope, used across life science, materials research, semiconductors, and energy materials for high-resolution nanoscale imaging and property characterization.

faqs.question: What is CleanDrive?
faqs.answer: Photothermal cantilever excitation — the most stable way to drive a cantilever, maintaining performance in both air and the liquid environments biological samples require.

faqs.question: What is WaveMode?
faqs.answer: The fastest off-resonance imaging mode on the market, in which the cantilever acts as both sensor and actuator, offering the most gentle imaging available to date with directly adjustable interaction force.

faqs.question: Can DriveAFM image in liquid?
faqs.answer: Yes. CleanDrive photothermal excitation ensures reliable performance in the liquid conditions needed to maintain biological sample integrity.

faqs.question: What sample sizes can DriveAFM handle?
faqs.answer: The tip-scanning design accommodates samples of various sizes and shapes, including large and heavy samples, without compromising performance.

faqs.question: Can DriveAFM be combined with optical microscopy?
faqs.answer: Yes. The scan head integrates seamlessly with an inverted optical microscope, combining transmitted light and fluorescence microscopy with AFM imaging and force spectroscopy.

faqs.question: What is automated on the system?
faqs.answer: Full motorization automates laser alignment, spring constant and sensitivity calibration, approach, and data acquisition.

faqs.question: Can DriveAFM operate inside a glovebox?
faqs.answer: Yes. All mechanical adjustments are controlled via software, and magnetic cantilever holders allow operation while wearing thick gloves.

faqs.question: Which electrical modes are supported?
faqs.answer: C-AFM, SSRM, PFM, EFM, KPFM, SMM, and MFM.

faqs.question: Which mechanical characterization modes are available?
faqs.answer: Force spectroscopy, modular spectroscopy, force modulation, and force mapping.

faqs.question: What is FluidFM?
faqs.answer: Cantilever-based microfluidics for spotting and deposition, single-cell manipulation, and nanomechanics, available with a dedicated cantilever holder.

faqs.question: What is PicoBalance?
faqs.answer: A capability providing mass measurements and frequency-resolved nanomechanics for deeper sample characterization.

faqs.question: Can small cantilevers be used?
faqs.answer: Yes. DriveAFM is compatible with high-fidelity small cantilevers, delivering faster imaging than regular cantilevers.

faqs.question: Is the software suitable for inexperienced users?
faqs.answer: Nanosurf Studio is designed to be easy to learn for novice users while retaining full flexibility for experts, with a configurable GUI and automated setup.

faqs.question: Can instrument control be scripted?
faqs.answer: Yes. Instrument control is fully scriptable, and new software releases arrive quarterly.

faqs.question: Where can I find detailed technical specifications?
faqs.answer: Numeric system specifications are published in the DriveAFM brochure rather than on the product page — Inkarp can provide it on request.

faqs.question: What is the price of DriveAFM in India?
faqs.answer: Get in touch and Inkarp will put together a quote based on the setup configuration, operating modes, and accessories required.

faqs.question: Who is the authorized distributor of DriveAFM in India?
faqs.answer: Inkarp is the authorized distributor and service provider for the Nanosurf DriveAFM in India, providing demonstration, installation, training, AMC, spare parts, and technical support.

longForm.heroHook: See the DNA double helix. Then measure a semiconductor's dopant profile. Same instrument.
longForm.heroLead: Most AFMs are built around a compromise — resolution or sample flexibility, speed or gentleness, biology or materials. DriveAFM is Nanosurf's answer to labs that refuse to make the choice. CleanDrive photothermal cantilever excitation is what makes it possible: the most stable way to drive a cantilever, holding performance even in the liquid conditions biological samples demand. That stability unlocks WaveMode, the fastest off-resonance imaging mode on the market, where the cantilever becomes both sensor and actuator. The tip-scanning design accommodates samples of any size or shape without performance loss — large, heavy materials samples included. Full motorization automates laser alignment, calibration, and approach. And it runs stand-alone or integrated with an inverted optical microscope, so AFM sits alongside fluorescence and transmitted light in one correlative workflow.

sections.title: Glovebox and Controlled Environments
body: Every mechanical adjustment is software-controlled — nothing requires physical access, which is what makes glovebox operation practical rather than merely possible.
Magnetic cantilever holders mean cantilever exchange works even through thick gloves, and the scan head is built to withstand the handling constraints of glovebox work.
Air- and moisture-sensitive samples remain in optimal conditions throughout characterization — the glovebox environment adds control without costing the nanoscale fidelity the platform provides.

comparison.disclaimer: The two share tip-scanning architecture, the same electrical mode set, FluidFM, and all three setup configurations. What DriveAFM adds is CleanDrive photothermal excitation and the WaveMode imaging it enables, the 28-bit controller as standard, full motorization, small cantilever support, and PicoBalance. Because accessories transfer between them, starting on FlexAFM and upgrading later is a supported route rather than a compromise that has to be unwound.

faqs.question: What is FlexAFM used for?
faqs.answer: It's a versatile mid-range research atomic force microscope used across materials science, life science, semiconductor, and energy materials research for nanoscale imaging and property characterization.

faqs.question: Can FlexAFM handle large samples?
faqs.answer: Yes. The tip-scanning design handles large samples without compromising versatility, robustness, or the system's compact size.

faqs.question: What controller does FlexAFM use?
faqs.answer: A 24-bit C3000i controller, enabling high-resolution imaging of single atomic layers as well as topography spanning several micrometres. A CX controller upgrade is available.

faqs.question: What does the CX controller upgrade add?
faqs.answer: It allows the system to be integrated with external hardware for advanced applications, and is the first step on the upgrade path to DriveAFM.

longForm.heroHook: Buy the mid-range AFM. Keep the accessories when you upgrade to the flagship.
longForm.heroLead: The usual problem with a mid-range instrument is that outgrowing it means starting over — new system, new sample holders, new accessories, the previous investment written off. Nanosurf built FlexAFM to avoid that. Its accessories and sample holders are compatible with DriveAFM, Nanosurf's most advanced research instrument, so upgrading the scan head later leaves everything else in place and working. The CX controller upgrade is the first deliberate step on that path. What sits underneath is a genuinely capable system in its own right. Tip-scanning design handles large samples without giving up compactness or robustness. A 24-bit C3000i controller resolves single atomic layers while still covering topography spanning several micrometres. It integrates with inverted optical microscopes from Zeiss, Nikon, Olympus, and Leica, or drops into a glovebox for sensitive 2D materials work — light enough to handle safely with one hand.

body: The build combines portability with the stability measurement requires — compact, lightweight, and robust, with alignment grooves that precisely position the cantilever and remove the fiddliest part of AFM setup.

faqs.question: What is CoreAFM used for?
faqs.answer: It's an all-in-one research atomic force microscope used across nanoscience and nanotechnology — materials characterization, 2D materials, electrical property analysis, life science work, and teaching.

faqs.question: What is included in the all-in-one design?
faqs.answer: A modern flexure-guided scanner, XYZ sample stage, sample observation camera, active vibration table, and airflow shielding, all integrated into a single unit.

faqs.question: How difficult is the system to set up?
faqs.answer: Three cables — connect the controller, plug in power and USB, and the system is ready to go.

faqs.question: Does CoreAFM need a separate vibration isolation table?

faqs.question: What controller does CoreAFM use?
faqs.answer: A specially designed 24-bit controller providing precise, reliable scan control alongside straightforward data acquisition and analysis.

faqs.question: How many operating modes are available?
faqs.answer: More than 30 optional modes and functions, spanning basic through advanced measurements.

faqs.question: Can CoreAFM measure in liquid?
faqs.answer: Yes. The system handles applications in both air and liquid environments.

faqs.question: Which electrical modes are supported?
faqs.answer: C-AFM, SSRM, PFM, EFM, KPFM, SMM, and MFM — the same seven modes as Nanosurf's higher-tier systems.

faqs.question: Is CoreAFM suitable for biological work?
faqs.answer: Yes. Nanosurf describes it as the only AFM in its class with versatility covering biological applications, with microscope integration available through DIMO.

faqs.question: What is DIMO?
faqs.answer: The Digital Inverted Microscope Option, providing the microscope integration life science AFM work generally requires.

faqs.question: Can CoreAFM run FluidFM?
faqs.answer: Yes — Nanosurf describes it as the most affordable path to FluidFM functionality.

faqs.question: What advanced options are available?
faqs.answer: Sample heating, environmental control, in-plane magnetic field control via a variable magnetic field generator, and scripting.

faqs.question: Can instrument control be scripted?
faqs.answer: Yes. Instrument control is fully scriptable, with Python scripting listed as a system feature.

faqs.question: Are software updates included?
faqs.answer: Nanosurf Core software includes free lifetime updates.

faqs.question: How is CoreAFM different from FlexAFM and DriveAFM?
faqs.answer: CoreAFM integrates everything including vibration isolation into one unit with three-cable setup. FlexAFM adds configurability across stand-alone, microscope, and glovebox setups plus large sample handling.
